docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY DAVIS, CRYSTAL AS TO DEFENDANT GARDNER, MARVIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-01-2022 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

ORDER TO CONTINUE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE.

SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
